us_chr_2025.publisher: County Health Rankings & Roadmaps (University of Wisconsin Population Health Institute); measures compiled from federal sources (NCHS/CDC WONDER, AHRF/HRSA, NPPES/CMS, CDC EPHT, US Census ACS/SAIPE, BLS, Feeding America for food insecurity, BRFSS/PLACES for adult behaviours)
us_chr_2025.dataset: CHR&R 2025 Annual Release, analytic data file (analytic_data2025_v3), county raw values
us_chr_2025.url_mirror: https://github.com/countyhealthrankings/snapshot (official CHR&R GitHub org) path parquet/analytic_data2025_v3.parquet + parquet/t_measure_years.parquet, commit 3c456c67fd34dbe49ebb270b25bc842a7cbd4c06
us_chr_2025.licence: CC BY 4.0 for the CHR&R annual release on Zenodo (publisher's own deposit); NOTE the GitHub snapshot repo itself carries CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 - attribute 'County Health Rankings & Roadmaps 2025' and cite the Zenodo CC BY release
us_chr_2025.period: 2025 release; per-field data years in values.csv `period` (taken from CHR t_measure_years for release 2025)
us_chr_2025.notes: Raw values only (no ranks/z-scores). Ratios converted: provider rates x100000 -> per 100k; proportions x100 -> %. Joined to Nestlyzer places by county containing the place point. Connecticut uses the 2022 planning regions (091xx). CHR 2025 has no violent-crime measure (dropped by CHR).

us_acs5_2023.dataset: American Community Survey 2019-2023 5-year estimates, table B19013 (median household income in the past 12 months, 2023 inflation-adjusted dollars), counties and states
us_acs5_2023.url_mirror: https://github.com/countyhealthrankings/county_health_measure_calculations path raw_data/ACS/acs_data_2019-2023.zip (acs_data_2019-2023.csv, unmodified API pull with E/M columns), commit e1e1c825059b5b260b4766d75f8449e3c7e7587d
us_acs5_2023.notes: Newer ACS 2020-2024 exists at census.gov but no full-county mirror was found.

us_saipe_2023.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau, Small Area Income and Poverty Estimates (SAIPE)
us_saipe_2023.dataset: 2023 Poverty and Median Household Income Estimates - Counties, States (est23all.xls), 'Poverty Percent, All Ages'
us_saipe_2023.notes: SAIPE 2024 has since been published (e.g. San Francisco 11.3 vs 11.9 for 2023); not mirrored.

us_bls_laus_2024.publisher: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Local Area Unemployment Statistics
us_bls_laus_2024.dataset: Labor Force Data by County, 2024 Annual Averages (laucnty24.xlsx), unemployment rate
us_bls_laus_2024.notes: BLS later revised some 2024 county rates (e.g. Nemaha KS 2.6 -> 2.5); 2025 annual averages now exist but are not mirrored.

jp_mic_fiscal_indices_fy2021.publisher: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications (総務省), Japan
jp_mic_fiscal_indices_fy2021.dataset: 全市町村の主要財政指標 令和3年度 (MIC main fiscal indicators, FY2021)
jp_mic_fiscal_indices_fy2021.licence: CC BY 4.0 compatible (MIC government standard terms of use, https://www.soumu.go.jp/menu_kyotsuu/policy/tyosaku.html)
jp_mic_fiscal_indices_fy2021.notes: MIC has since published FY2022-FY2024 (newest 令和6年度); only FY2021 is mirrored. Join via point-in-polygon on Geoshape municipal boundaries 2021-01-01 (ROIS-DS CODH, CC BY-SA 4.0, same repo maps/20210101/jp_city_dc.i.topojson; used for the join only, not redistributed). Designated cities are one unit (wards merged); Tokyo special wards are separate.

il_cbs_local_authorities_2021.publisher: Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS / הלשכה המרכזית לסטטיסטיקה), Israel
il_cbs_local_authorities_2021.dataset: Local Authorities in Israel 2021 - data file (p_libud_2021.xlsx, sheet 'נתונים פיזיים ונתוני אוכלוסייה', updated 11/12/2023) + Localities file 2021 (bycode2021.xlsx) for coordinates and regional-council membership
il_cbs_local_authorities_2021.url_mirror: https://github.com/cran/il.cbs.muni (CRAN mirror of R package il.cbs.muni 0.1.0) path inst/extdata/p_libud_2021.xlsx and inst/extdata/bycode2021.xlsx, commit 45f1b5e9a8481b349961db9bf46c13ae58ef4936
il_cbs_local_authorities_2021.licence: CBS publications may be reused with source attribution (CBS terms of use); package MIT
il_cbs_local_authorities_2021.period: file year 2021; per-field data years in `period` (2017-2021 life expectancy, 2019 wages/SE index, 2020 peripherality, 2020/21-2021/22 education)
il_cbs_local_authorities_2021.notes: Values are for the local authority (municipality, local council, or regional council for localities inside regional councils). Life expectancy only for cities 50k+; convictions only for authorities 50k+.
